scope: Read every original source/access/book envelope, original individual question and all current director questions. No earlier full procedures/cases exist; no new authoring decisions or acceptance.

perIdentityFindings.banishment-field: ALL extraplanar recipients includes qualifying allies/caster; type/ancestry does not authenticate extraplanar status. Keep source-specific eligibility separate from known native-plane destination. A finite individual cell model and terminal-return bypass require new named extensions, with independent saves/admission outcomes and whole-body cargo histories.
perIdentityFindings.summon-greater-earth-pet: Keep80HP/20AC/2d10 and knockdown. New full body/profile must not silently import tunneling/multiattack or mineral harvest. Wizard creationHP requires an actually acquired eligible creation feature, not just school. Actual born phase/command perception/offensive allowance shared across assets is required.
perIdentityFindings.volcanic-cage: The1–3 target promise, fire amount, CON-control save and molten trap all remain. Clarify damage/save linkage; no repeated6d6 by inference. Unsupported targets need an explicit lawful initial placement or failed admission, not automatic hovering. Physical cage segments, HP, exit, suppression and re-expression cannot intersect occupants or erase current gear.
perIdentityFindings.prismatic-conflux: Finite actual enemy set must be fixed before random rolls; per-target elemental type and damage draws need an explicit native table. No Prismatic Spray riders, vulnerability fishing or hidden-enemy identification. Each original recipient has a separate damage root under the same cast identity.
perIdentityFindings.resonance-storm: Recurring recovery contradicts Instantaneous and needs an explicit duration choice. Damage tag grants no damage. Need real round/elapsed pulse identities and actual RP-only caps/gain prohibitions. Quantify multiple allies and caster17RP/discount/Grand Reservoir waiver cases; no free cap/cooling/use refresh. CompanionLife05 is now applied within its exact scopes; an old pending label must not reopen its accepted spells or expand Soulburn exception.
perIdentityFindings.faction-citadel: Require a complete24-hour structure, support/load and finite segment profile, authentic faction permission and physical access. A roof/walls do not prove Haven safety, trained staff, tools, fuel, supplies or completed work. Floor suppression may cause a real fall; safe teleport release is an explicit new rule rather than an implied benefit.
perIdentityFindings.alignment-avatar: Conjuration school does not make transformation into newly created creatureHP. Keep self wording versus120ft conflict explicit. Every permitted alignment route needs full finite body/abilities, same HP/Wounds/resources and true gear compatibility. Compare accepted Body8/Formlock for priority without granting new unreviewed profiles or inferring theology.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: ALL extraplanar creatures in30ft radius, CHA save or banished; Core Action/range30/InstantaneousVSF.
preservedQuestions.options: A: one source-defined finite area admission event, with exact source-backed extraplanar eligibility. B: infer planar origin from ancestry/type or turn Field into an endless portal.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A as a proposed completion. Choose point within30 versus self center, full three-dimensional sphere/body intersection and center line of effect; ALL eligible creatures includes allies and caster if actually eligible. A creature type or appearance is not proof of extraplanar status. Distinguish a source-explicit extraplanar tag from unknown native/home plane; no plane ancestry or soul origin is invented. Discuss whether existing accepted tag-only Greater Planar Ally qualifies without a known home destination.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Failed CHA save requires BANISHMENT, but no duration/destination/return is printed.
preservedQuestions.options: A: explicitly extend the accepted finite individual exile-cell model to each admitted recipient. B: permanent native-plane deportation or reuse ordinary Banishment by unstated analogy.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A only as a declared new named extension with finite duration/concentration. Preserve the original Instantaneous record and explain the new lifecycle. Supply per-body cell dimensions, admission/cargo/dependent creatures, support, safety and origin snapshot. Choose separate versus shared cells; do not strand unwilling linked companions, delete gear or automatically carry a grappled independent creature. A successful save has a stated no-exile result, no damage by inference.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: An area can meet many simultaneous saves/admissions and established terminal-return prevention rules.
preservedQuestions.options: A: exact stable recipient order and independent admission/result records with a new explicit terminal exception if adopted. B: one shared save, caster-chosen favorable ordering or borrowing BAN-CLOSE-03 silently.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose original source attack/save/DC provenance, arrival prevention, known/hidden failure and costs. Determine whether one failed admission affects others. State concentration loss, caster death/absence, suppression inside/outside, expired cells and collision-safe terminal return. Only existing ordinary Banishment and two named AC5 extensions presently own their closure exception; extending to this field is new. Pending Dimensional Lock/Plane Shift rules grant no authority.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: HP80,AC20,Tremor Slam2d10 and knocks Prone; Action120Conc60VSF.
preservedQuestions.options: A: complete new finite native Elemental companion profile preserving all printed numbers. B: import an external earth elemental or infer burrowing, multiattack and mineral stock from its name.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Choose actual size/occupied volume/height/mass, six abilities, saves/skills, senses, speech/understanding, walking and any explicitly added modes, anatomy/handling and cargo. Assign no extra resistances, tunneling, seismic detection or regeneration by inference. Actual Wizard creationHP addition and dynamic maximumHP apply only when their exact source gates hold; no arbitrary CR or free subclass power.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Tremor Slam has no printed attack type, damage type, reach or knockdown save.
preservedQuestions.options: A: one direct melee spell attack2d10 Bludgeoning followed by a source-local size-qualified save against Prone. B: area earthquake/multiple slams without an explicit source decision.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A as NEW comparison to the accepted lesser Earth Pet, retaining its complete distinct profile. Choose reach, exact size gate, save stat, timing and immunity behavior; hit damage and Prone are separate. A missed attack does not knock down. A hovering/airborne or anchored body obeys actual Prone/fall/source immunity, not automatic grounding or terrain creation. No flat damage modifier or extra attack is inferred.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Actual companion creation, command and attached phase differ from a free independent actor.
preservedQuestions.options: A: reuse exact owner-wide command/offense and birth-phase rules with a named lifecycle. B: autonomous free Slam every extra turn or restart life on suppression.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define120ft formation versus command range, true empty supported space, observed/perceived delivered order, lawful nondamaging work, no-command behavior and creation-round eligibility. One offense is shared with other owner assets; real stats do not grant tools/proficiencies. Choose partial/full suppression and terminal0HP rules preserving carried external gear; no creature duplication, corpse mineral harvest or hidden planar-origin label.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Trap1–3 creatures in molten rock;6d6 Fire, CON save or immobilized; Action120InstantaneousVSF.
preservedQuestions.options: A: select up to3 actually legal bodies, with separate CON results and explicit damage/result linkage. B: one-target generic fire attack or repeated6d6 each turn by inference.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A. Choose target perception/line, creature size limits, body-ground requirements and selection at commitment/release. Is Fire always full or halved on successful CON, and does the same save determine immobilization? Preserve both damage and trap benefits without silently changing the save stat. State shared versus independent dice with ordinary per-recipient defenses/Null roots.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Molten rock implies a trap but supplies no physical cage statistics or duration.
preservedQuestions.options: A: complete finite spell-local restraint plus explicitly defined material manifestation. B: infer total cover, suffocation, paralysis, continuous lava damage and permanent stone.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose actual immobilized mechanics (for example only voluntary Speed0, not all Restrained riders), finite duration/concentration, cage geometry/fit and body positions. If physical, supply whole object or segments, actualAC/HP/defenses and legal attack targeting. If nonphysical, explain how the printed trap is expressed. Define real support/flying target behavior and legal escape ability/task/action versus end-save; no hidden teleport permission or free physical movement.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: A cage may break or be suppressed while an occupant is moving or carrying real equipment.
preservedQuestions.options: A: preserved exact component identities with safe re-expression and finite release. B: recast HP reset, squeezing occupied space, free rock harvest or erasure of gear.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: State overlap/recast, destruction per cage and effect on other recipients, local suppression versus ending, occupied return boundaries, source expiry and genuine dispel. Completed Fire damage never reverses. Real gear/body histories and external objects survive; classify residual apparent rock explicitly. Provide a legal exit rather than indefinite pending collision if the source ends, under actual body-placement rules.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Each enemy takes2d8 random elemental type, roll separately; Action120InstantaneousVSF.
preservedQuestions.options: A: exact bounded selection/area with independent per-enemy type and damage draws. B: import the seven-effect Prismatic Spray table or reroll for vulnerabilities.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A with finite actual range/shape, enemy predicate and snapshot. Preserve each enemy rather than arbitrarily remove legal recipients; discuss perception versus area admission and line of effect. Explicitly decide whether source permits attack/save and the successful outcome. Resolve both meanings of roll separately; no selective post-roll enemy list or allied damage by inference.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Native elemental damage types and random presentation require a finite exact table.
preservedQuestions.options: A: declare a complete spell-local table drawn from actual native damage types. B: assume every damage type is elemental or create new Light/Dark/Chaos types.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose type table/fair draw, independent damage dice per recipient, stable processing order and event ownership before defenses. Type roll must precede resistance/immunity/vulnerability and cannot inspect hidden weaknesses to reroll. Use existing public/presentation rules; a new random table is not a sixth Fate presentation. No control riders, persistent area, stealth roster query or weather effect is inferred.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Storm restores1d6RP to ALLIES EACH ROUND; Core Action120InstantaneousVSF and misleading Damage tag.
preservedQuestions.options: A: explicit finite non-damaging recovery field with real pulse schedule. B: once-only recovery, continuous free rest, damage storm or unbounded round generator.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A preserving every legal per-round1d6 opportunity within an explicitly chosen duration/concentration/area. Choose real ally and caster eligibility, clipping/LoE, shared or per-recipient die, first pulse and original recurring phase outside initiative. Extra turns/round renumbering/move-out-and-in do not generate extra opportunities; source/recipient admission records need exact identities. The Damage tag alone grants no damage, Null payload, rain or weather control.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Actual RP pools, gain bans, capped recovery and other class resource engines differ.
preservedQuestions.options: A: restore actual RP only, with exact current recipient eligibility/caps and retained prohibitions. B: fill RP plus OracleRC/MirrorsageEcho/companions or cool every class burden.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define whether capped or forbidden grants consume scheduled opportunities, never exceeding actualRPmax. No HP, Dissonance, Strain, fatigue, invocation/use/capacity refresh or recovery from an unrelated resource by inference. Recipient zeroRP can be legal only if its actual source permits gaining. Any nonzero-pool minimum or recipient cap is new and must be justified instead of erasing printed allies.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Repeated group casts, discounts and free-cast features can produce repeated positive resource recovery.
preservedQuestions.options: A: explicitly choose finite source/recipient creation/receipt limits and a legal beneficial-rest refresh. B: unexplained blanket prohibition on all recovery or unlimited self-funding recasts.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Discuss exact once-per-rest or other proposed budgets while retaining1d6 per allowed round; quantify ordinary17RP, Nexus/Influence discounts and real Wizard20 Grand Reservoir waiver cases. Resonance Well has its own creation/draw uses and one reserve, not this spell; Soulburn Current05 has a still-pending scoped intrinsic exception, not a universal refund rule. Specify waiver/recovery eligibility explicitly. No auto-granted new use/refund exemption or party pooling bypass.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Overlapping sources and temporary suppression change actual recovery opportunities.
preservedQuestions.options: A: exact same-family arbitration and consumed event identity with original clocks. B: bank blocked pulses, retime the source or replay every missed recovery on restoration.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose one strongest/earliest family application or complete alternate explicit stacking rule, who rolls and when history is consumed. Recast replacement, caster death, dispel, local suppression, recipient exit/reentry and RPmax changes need full results. Ordinary canceled healing rules do not automatically define RP transfer. Show at least one blocked pulse and resumed future pulse without replay.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Conjure a faction-aligned fortress for24hours; Action120VSF.
preservedQuestions.options: A: complete finite native structure profile and actual faction invocation predicate. B: personal ward, imported mansion, new faction jurisdiction or automatic army garrison.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A preserving86400elapsed seconds without silent concentration addition. Choose complete footprint/height/floors/rooms/access/doors/windows/stairs/roofs/walls and receiving support; provide finite structural segments/AC/HP/defenses and load capacity. Placement must respect actual occupied volumes, terrain and full range/LoE. All new dimensions/components are explicit authorship; no staff, free supplies, remote storage plane or sovereign territory follows.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Aligned with your faction is not identical to every faction aid/invocation source.
preservedQuestions.options: A: exact known canonical faction, actual affiliation/permission and current eligible standing where adopted. B: forged insignia, private score disclosure or creating membership by casting.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose who owns access, actual door controls and whether designation/reputation changes after creation affect use. Do not transfer Faction Army positive-standing aid gates without explicitly selecting them for this fortress. A real enemy entering through an open door obeys physical rules unless an actual ward is authored. No hidden faction recognition, instant expulsion, offensive turret or invented political authority.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: A fortress can provide real shelter/workspace but Haven, camp and crafting status have additional prerequisites.
preservedQuestions.options: A: admit physical capabilities through existing full expedition/crafting rules. B: automatic Haven safety, food, trained staff, workshop qualification, rest rewards or recipe completion.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Supply actual shelter/lighting/ventilation/bed/rest conditions and choose which structures are genuinely present. Existing tools, fuel, reagents, workers, threats, permissions, real work time and exposed schedules remain required. The source may satisfy an actual wall/roof/site component once its profile proves it, but does not automatically certify a Haven, research base or qualified station. No compounding free rent/material/wealth loop.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: 24-hour structure ending/destruction/suppression intersects real occupants, cargo and support.
preservedQuestions.options: A: conserved external body/property and source-specific structural ending with actual fall/rescue rules. B: delete occupants/cargo, clone furnishing stock or teleport everybody safely without a stated procedure.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define genuine movable versus intrinsic fixtures, localized damage/destruction, partial suppression, return into newly occupied space, source expiry and voluntary ending/recast. Removing a floor can remove real support; choose any special safe release as explicit NEW, not an automatic free relocation. No reset of actual cargo damage or duplication/harvesting of conjured stone. Exact large-structure family limits and reappearance must remain finite.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Transform into an avatar OF YOUR ALIGNMENT with powerful abilities; Core Action120InstantaneousVSF.
preservedQuestions.options: A: source-specific finite self transformation keyed to actual effective alignment pair. B: allied summon, assumed god/native plane/soul identity or broad moral entitlement.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend A as mechanics-only new design, preserving Core120 conflict explicitly rather than permitting arbitrary target transformation. Use actual accepted effective-pair history/overlays; undefined axes are not guessed from conduct/type. Choose snapshot versus live reassessment and duration/concentration. Alignment is neither a new deity nor a native-origin assertion; cosmology identities remain unresolved where already qualified.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Powerful abilities gives no complete stat/profile list.
preservedQuestions.options: A: full bounded native form profiles for every admitted alignment route, with explicit shared profile and per-route differences. B: undefined choose-any-power, external celestial/fiend stat blocks or a single bonus that drops transformation.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Provide actual bodies/size/mass/height/anatomy/speeds/senses, creature type/source classification, ability/AC/HP rules, attacks/actions/resources and exact defenses. If not all routes can be authored coherently, retain named content holds instead of invented access. Power from an alignment axis must have explicit finite mechanics and costs; no moral superiority hierarchy, resistance/immunity or instant death/banishment by association.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Self transformation intersects one-body HP, maximumHP, current equipment and casting/class features.
preservedQuestions.options: A: preserve original identity/life and apply exact form/gear compatibility with every new capability bounded. B: second life bar, freeHP reset, duplicated equipment or new class progression.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose unchanged versus source-explicit ability/AC modifications, genuine maximumHP clamp/recovery, temporaryHP and existing injuries/Wounds. Define hands/voice/components, meld/drop/retained gear and carried-load effects, eligible original learned spells and new profile attacks. A Conjuration school does not make the caster a freshly created summon eligible for creationHP; no extra companion action/command or copied class powers. Suppression/end must not heal completed damage.

preservedQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Multiple forms, effective alignment changes, suppression and source ending can conflict.
preservedQuestions.options: A: explicit source-family precedence, real form fit and finite exit preserving history. B: freely chain alternate alignments/forms to reset resources or replace body location.
preservedQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Choose interaction with Polymorph/True Polymorph/Druid and accepted one-form rules, failure when new shape cannot fit, loss of consciousness/death and genuine dispel. Snapshot or live alignment behavior must agree withQ20. No hidden alignment diagnostic, unearned access to every profile or permanent appearance/theology rewrite. Define partial/full suppression and whether old anatomy resumes only in legal space with real gear custody retained.

futureCaseRequirements: After actual choices, at least two complete legal current scenarios per identity plus every distinct new form/profile and source branch. No missing profile is supplied merely by a convenient HP value.
Actual caster class/level/repertoire/RP/components, true bodies/volumes/masses/gear, ordinary start/end/Ready/attached companion timing and complete source-owner damage roots.

Banishment Field all qualifying allies/enemies, tagged versus unknown origin, independent CHA saves/cell admissions, real cargo and surviving terminal-return exceptions with no native-plane invention.
Greater Earth Pet actual80HP/20AC before eligible modifiers, hit/miss and separate prone save, source-qualified body/support/commands, real attack count and suppression/life behavior.
Volcanic Cage up to3 recipients, separate damage/save/control, airborne/full-body fit, real physical cage if adopted, escape/destruction, independent cages and support loss on suppression/end.

Prismatic Conflux actual complete enemy set and legal area, distinct per-target elemental types/damage draws, immunity/vulnerability after type selection, no hidden roster leak or extra Fate presentation.

Resonance Storm actual caster/recipient pools and1d6 opportunities, legal real pulse/round timeline, ordinary cost versus discount/waiver, full/forbidden gains, multiple owners and suppression without replay or free refresh.

Faction Citadel complete real structure, safe initial placement, actual faction permission, legal shelter/worksite/Haven prerequisites, damage/expiry with external occupants/gear and ordinary support/fall rules.

Alignment Avatar each admitted effective alignment route, all complete new profile capabilities, true self body/HP/Wounds/equipment and form precedence, original class engine, undefined alignment and suppression/end.
All conditional source gaps remain explicit holds. No authored numeric scenario is gameplay execution, human balance or cosmology closure.
